params.name: S_FACTS_requestJson
params.defaultValue:
{"model": "gpt-5.6-sol", "reasoningEffort": "max", "maxTokens": 2400, "prompt": "You are syncing Zendesk tickets to Salesforce. The evidence JSON contains blocklist rows, SLA rows, config rows, Zendesk tickets, Zendesk users and organizations, Salesforce contacts and accounts, and existing_cases.
Return ONLY a JSON object with this shape:
{"create":[{"ticket_id":"...","subject":"...","requester_email":"...","contact_id":"...","account_id":"...","account_name":"...","priority":"..."}],"skip":[{"ticket_id":"...","reason":"..."}]}
Rules:
- Only tickets whose status is new or open are candidates.
- Skip a candidate if the requester email domain appears in the blocklist with Status Blocked, or if no Salesforce contact matches the requester email exactly.
- Skip a candidate when an existing Salesforce case already has the same subject and the same AccountId (this is an incremental sync; do not create duplicates).
- Priority: if the domain has blocklist Status Warning -> Low; else if the domain's SLA Tier is Platinum -> Critical; else if the requester's Zendesk organization has tag 'enterprise' -> High; else Medium.
- Preserve subjects and names verbatim.
- There must be exactly 5 create entries and 6 skip entries.
Evidence:
{{support_evidence}}"}
